question: What does Paul urge Timothy to stir up?
explanation: Paul tells Timothy to stir up the gift of God that is in him.

question: What kind of spirit does Paul say God has not given us?
explanation: Paul says God has not given believers the spirit of fear.

question: What was Timothy told not to be ashamed of?
choices: The testimony of the Lord and Paul His prisoner
explanation: Timothy was not to be ashamed of the testimony of the Lord nor of Paul His prisoner.

question: What two relatives does Paul mention as examples of sincere faith?
explanation: Paul recalls the sincere faith that first dwelt in Timothy's grandmother Lois and mother Eunice.

question: Who was not ashamed of Paul's chain and often refreshed him?
explanation: Onesiphorus often refreshed Paul and was not ashamed of his chain.

question: In what is Timothy told to be strong?
choices: The grace that is in Christ Jesus
explanation: Paul tells Timothy to be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

question: To whom was Timothy to commit what he had learned?
choices: Faithful men who would teach others also
explanation: Timothy was to entrust truth to faithful men who could teach others.

question: What three examples does Paul use to describe endurance and discipline?
choices: A king, a priest, and a prophet
A soldier, an athlete, and a farmer
A servant, a ruler, and a teacher
A shepherd, a builder, and a judge
explanation: Paul speaks of a good soldier, a man who strives for masteries (an athlete), and a husbandman (a farmer).

question: What is Timothy told to rightly divide?
explanation: Paul tells Timothy to rightly divide the word of truth.

question: What does Paul say will come in the last days?
explanation: Paul warns that perilous times shall come in the last days.

question: What will people have while denying its power?
explanation: Paul says they will have a form of godliness but deny its power.

question: What does Paul say all who will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer?
explanation: Paul says all that live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

question: What had Timothy known from childhood?
explanation: Timothy had known the holy scriptures from a child.

question: How does Paul describe all Scripture?
explanation: All Scripture is given by inspiration of God.

question: What does Paul charge Timothy to do?
explanation: Paul solemnly charges Timothy to preach the word.

question: What will people no longer endure?
explanation: Paul says the time will come when people will not endure sound doctrine.

question: What does Paul say he is now ready for?
explanation: Paul says he is now ready to be offered, and the time of his departure is at hand.

question: What three things does Paul say he has done?
choices: I have fought a good fight, finished my course, and kept the faith
I have believed, endured, and taught
I have served the church, loved the brethren, and finished strong
I have preached the word, corrected error, and endured persecution
explanation: Paul says he fought a good fight, finished his course, and kept the faith.

question: What is laid up for Paul?
explanation: Paul says a crown of righteousness is laid up for him.

question: Whom does Paul call his dearly beloved son?
explanation: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son.

question: Who hath abolished death?
explanation: Our Saviour Jesus Christ hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.

question: What is Paul appointed as?
choices: A preacher, an apostle and a teacher of the Gentiles
explanation: I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

question: Who turned away from Paul?
choices: All they which are in Asia
explanation: All they which are in Asia be turned away from me.

question: What does Paul remember about Timothy that makes him long to see him?
explanation: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears.

question: With what does Paul say he serves God from his forefathers?
explanation: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience.

question: How did Timothy receive the gift of God?
choices: By the putting on of Paul's hands
explanation: Stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

question: Not according to our works, but according to what has God saved us?
explanation: Not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace.

question: Where did Onesiphorus seek Paul out diligently?
explanation: When he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.

question: What is Timothy to hold fast?
explanation: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me.

question: By whom is Timothy to keep that good thing committed to him?
explanation: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.

question: Through what has Christ brought life and immortality to light?
explanation: He hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.

question: For whose house does Paul ask mercy from the Lord?
explanation: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus.

question: Which two men are named among those in Asia who turned away?
explanation: Of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

question: What is the Lord able to keep until that day?
choices: That which Paul has committed to him
explanation: I am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

question: At which city did Onesiphorus minister to Paul in many things?
explanation: In how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

question: When was grace given us in Christ Jesus?
choices: At the giving of the law
explanation: His own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began.

question: Be partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to what?
explanation: Be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God.

question: When does Paul remember Timothy in his prayers?
explanation: Without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day.

question: Why does Paul greatly desire to see Timothy?
choices: That Timothy may take his place
That he may send him to Asia
That he may be filled with joy
explanation: Greatly desiring to see thee, that I may be filled with joy.

question: What does Paul say of the faith in Timothy?
explanation: I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee.

question: Paul is an apostle according to what?
choices: The promise of life which is in Christ Jesus
explanation: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus.

question: Who is of the seed of David and was raised from the dead?
explanation: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel.

question: What does Paul say is not bound?
explanation: I suffer trouble, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

question: What did Hymenaeus and Philetus say about the resurrection?
choices: That it is yet to come
That it is only for the elect
explanation: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already.

question: Which vessels are in a great house besides gold and silver?
explanation: There are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth.

question: What is Timothy told to flee?
explanation: Flee also youthful lusts.

question: How must the servant of the Lord be toward all men?
explanation: The servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men.

question: What shall happen if we suffer with him?
choices: We shall be rewarded with gold
We shall also reign with him
explanation: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him.

question: To what does Paul compare the word of the profane babblers?
explanation: Their word will eat as doth a canker.

question: What does Paul say of those who deny him?
choices: He will rebuke them in love
explanation: If we deny him, he also will deny us.

question: Why is a man who strives for masteries not crowned?
explanation: If a man strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

question: Who must be first partaker of the fruits?
explanation: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

question: Why does a soldier not entangle himself with the affairs of this life?
choices: To please him who chose him
explanation: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

question: Why does Paul endure all things for the elect's sakes?
choices: That they may obtain salvation with eternal glory
explanation: I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

question: If we be dead with him, what shall follow?
choices: We shall also live with him
explanation: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him.

question: Why can the Lord not deny himself?
choices: He abideth faithful even when we believe not
explanation: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

question: What do profane and vain babblings increase to?
explanation: Shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

question: What seal does the foundation of God have?
choices: The Lord knoweth them that are his
explanation: The foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his.

question: What are those who name Christ's name to depart from?
explanation: Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

question: What is Timothy to follow with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart?
explanation: Follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

question: What are those who oppose themselves held captive by?
explanation: They may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

question: What do foolish and unlearned questions gender?
explanation: Foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

question: What kind of workman is Timothy to show himself?
choices: One approved unto God who needeth not to be ashamed
explanation: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed.

question: How does Paul suffer in the gospel?
choices: As an evil doer, even unto bonds
As a slave in the city
explanation: I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds.

question: What may God peradventure give those who oppose themselves?
explanation: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance.

question: What does the man who purges himself become?
choices: A vessel of gold and silver
A vessel unto honour, meet for the master's use
explanation: He shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use.

question: What does Paul ask the Lord to give Timothy?
explanation: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

question: What was Timothy to commit to faithful men?
choices: The things he heard of Paul among many witnesses
explanation: The things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men.

question: What must the servant of the Lord be besides gentle?
explanation: Be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient.

question: What does charging them not to strive about words do?
explanation: Charging them not to strive about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

question: Unto what is the purged vessel prepared?
explanation: Sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.

question: What did the error of Hymenaeus and Philetus do to some?
explanation: They overthrow the faith of some.

question: What must the servant of the Lord not do?
explanation: The servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men.

question: Before whom does Paul charge them not to strive about words?
explanation: Charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit.

question: At whose will are those who oppose themselves taken captive?
explanation: They are taken captive by him at his will.

question: In a great house, some vessels are to honour and some to what?
explanation: Some to honour, and some to dishonour.

question: In the last days, whom shall men love?
explanation: In the last days men shall be lovers of their own selves.

question: Who withstood Moses?
explanation: As Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth.

question: What shall evil men and seducers do?
explanation: Evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

question: What are the holy scriptures able to make Timothy?
explanation: The holy scriptures are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

question: Whom shall men love more than God in the last days?
explanation: Lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God.

question: To whom shall men be disobedient in the last days?
explanation: Boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents.

question: What does Paul say of those with a form of godliness?
explanation: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

question: Whom do those who creep into houses lead captive?
explanation: They creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins.

question: What are those who are ever learning never able to come to?
explanation: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

question: At which cities did persecutions come upon Paul?
explanation: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra.

question: What is Scripture profitable for?
choices: Doctrine, reproof, correction, instruction in righteousness
explanation: All scripture is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness.

question: What is the man of God made by Scripture?
choices: Perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works
explanation: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

question: Of what are men in the last days despisers?
explanation: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, despisers of those that are good.

question: What will happen to the resisters of the truth?
choices: They will be cast out of the church
explanation: They shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men.

question: What kind of minds do the resisters have?
explanation: Men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

question: Led away by what are the silly women laden with sins?
explanation: Silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts.

question: Besides doctrine, what did Paul say Timothy had fully known?
choices: His manner of life and purpose
explanation: Thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience.

question: What do evil men and seducers do besides growing worse?
explanation: Deceiving, and being deceived.

question: What did the Lord do for Paul out of all his persecutions?
explanation: But out of them all the Lord delivered me.

question: Through what faith do the scriptures make Timothy wise unto salvation?
choices: Faith in the law of Moses
Faith which is in Christ Jesus
explanation: Able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

question: What was Timothy to continue in?
choices: The things he had learned and been assured of
explanation: Continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of.

question: Which of these is said of men in the last days?
explanation: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God.

question: Who has forsaken Paul, having loved this present world?
explanation: Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world.

question: Who alone is with Paul?
explanation: Only Luke is with me.

question: What did Paul leave at Troas with Carpus?
explanation: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, bring with thee.

question: Who did Paul say did him much evil?
explanation: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil.

question: Whom shall the Lord Jesus Christ judge?
explanation: The Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom.

question: Whom does Paul tell Timothy to take with him?
explanation: Take Mark, and bring him with thee.

question: Where did Demas go?
explanation: Demas is departed unto Thessalonica.

question: Where did Titus go?
explanation: Titus unto Dalmatia.

question: Where had Paul sent Tychicus?
explanation: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

question: Why does Paul want Mark?
choices: He is profitable for the ministry
explanation: Take Mark: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

question: What happened at Paul's first answer?
explanation: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me.

question: Who stood with Paul and strengthened him?
explanation: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me.

question: Before what season is Timothy to come to Paul?
explanation: Do thy diligence to come before winter.

question: What will people heap to themselves because of itching ears?
explanation: After their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears.

question: What is Timothy to do besides watching and enduring afflictions?
explanation: Watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist.

question: Which two are greeted by Paul at the end?
explanation: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

question: Who did Paul leave at Miletum sick?
explanation: Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

question: Where did Erastus abide?
explanation: Erastus abode at Corinth.

question: What did Paul especially ask Timothy to bring?
explanation: Bring with thee the books, but especially the parchments.

question: What does Paul say about Alexander's reward?
choices: The Lord reward him according to his works
explanation: The Lord reward him according to his works.

question: What does Paul pray about those who forsook him?
choices: That it not be laid to their charge
explanation: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.

question: Where did Crescens go?
explanation: Crescens to Galatia.

question: Why did the Lord strengthen Paul at his first answer?
choices: That all the Gentiles might hear the preaching
That the judge might release him
explanation: The Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear.

question: To what shall people be turned when they turn away from the truth?
explanation: They shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

question: Which of these sends greetings with Eubulus?
explanation: Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia.

question: When is Timothy to preach the word?
explanation: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season.

question: Unto what will the Lord preserve Paul?
explanation: The Lord will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom.

question: With what is Timothy to reprove, rebuke and exhort?
explanation: Reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
